## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-15 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /front-desk, By status and By doctor · receptionist first; nurse and doctor · 768 to 1440, and a list under 768.
Findings and reviewers: F-12, F-14 · reviewers A-11, B-02, B-05, B-06, B-19, C-23.
Rationale: The first card starts at about 452 px at every width from 768 to 1440: 41 % of a 1024 by 768 screen is left for patients. With two doctors the card does not say whose patient it is. At 1024 px the action label wraps and the time sits outside the card. On a phone the board is six 156 px columns.
Proposed UX behaviour: The board stays (ruling 4). One 44 px header row: title and date, the view switch (SegmentedControl), the live mark, actions. A one-line workload strip per doctor. Column headers stay pinned; columns are at least 208 px; an empty column collapses to a 48 px stub with its name and count. Card: patient name, time, the doctor's short name when more than one doctor works that day, flags on one line, one action with a short label at 44 px. Only the next action for the signed-in user is a filled button. Under 768 px the board is one list with status tabs. Card actions, their order and the walk-in path do not change.
Prototype and blueprint reference: Reviewer B section 11.2 for the board chrome. docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/desk-1440.png and desk-768.png show the later list view, not this ticket.
Components and tokens affected: PageHeader, SegmentedControl, Chip, Card (list item). No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the codemod, the shell components ticket (PageHeader), the page components ticket (SegmentedControl) and the undo ticket of track S, so that Undo and Left without being seen are placed once. Owns BoardPage.tsx and FrontDeskViews.tsx while open.
Clinical sign-off: Not clinical. The receptionist confirms at the validation session (receptionist scenario steps 1, 6 and 7); question 20 (devices at the desk) informs the widths.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: 19 test files, 55 references to the board.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Replacing the board with a list (forbidden before the pilot by ruling 4; the list comes later as a third view). (2) Drag and drop. (3) Compact rows: every card action stays 44 px.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given nine visits at 1024 by 768, when the board loads, then the first card starts at or above 220 px
- [ ] **AC2.** Given widths from 768 to 1440 px and a long patient name, when the board renders, then no text is outside its card and the action label is on one line
- [ ] **AC3.** Given two doctors working today, when a card renders, then it shows the doctor's short name in words; given one doctor, then it does not
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a long column, when it is scrolled, then its header with name and count stays visible
- [ ] **AC5.** Given 375 px, when the board opens, then it is one list with status tabs and no sideways scrolling
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the walk-in path after this change, when it is measured, then a new patient takes at most 6 clicks and a returning patient at most 3
- [ ] **AC7.** Given the board for a doctor, when the first viewport is counted, then at most one filled primary button is visible
- [ ] **AC8.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs at 1440, 1024 and 375, then there is no violation
